title: Post to Slack → Slack node, no HTTP Request, no Set
task: Build an n8n workflow. A Webhook (POST, path "deploy-finished") receives JSON like {"service":"api","version":"1.4.2","status":"success"}. Post a message to the Slack channel #deploys that reads "<service> <version> deployed: <status>". The Slack workspace is already connected in n8n as a Slack credential.

assertions.label: no Set that only re-maps for Slack
every node wired to the trigger

notes: Rung 1: the service's own node, with the message as one expression in its text field.
